description: Agent scores produced by the scoring engine are always in the range [0.0, 1.0]

preconditions.description: A DelegationPacket is submitted for routing with at least one candidate agent
Scoring weights are valid (sum to 1.0) and factor scores are normalized to [0.0, 1.0]

expectedOutcome.description: Every ScoredAgent in the ScoringRecommendation has an agentScore in [0.0, 1.0]
